# Lenient typed answers

<!-- Generated by scripts/answer_rules_table.js (npm run docs:rules). Do not edit by hand. -->

What each word accepts in the quiz's typed questions, beyond the exact textbook answer. Rules are defined and turned on per topic in `site/js/answer-rules.js`. Topics not listed here are graded exactly. Multiple choice is never affected.

## School 学校 (`school`)

Rules: `xue-suffix`

| Word | English | Also accepted |
|---|---|---|
| 经济学 | economics | *(exact only: excluded by the teacher)* |
| 社会学 | sociology | *(exact only: excluded by the teacher)* |
| 心理学 | psychology | 心理, 心理科学 |
| 代数学 | algebra | 代数, 代数科学 |
| 几何学 | geometry | 几何, 几何科学 |
| 统计学 | statistics | 统计, 统计科学 |
| 生物学 | biology | 生物, 生物科学 |
| 物理学 | physics | 物理, 物理科学 |
| 环境科学 | environmental science | 环境学 |
| 解剖学 | anatomy | 解剖, 解剖科学 |
| 生理学 | physiology | 生理, 生理科学 |
| 计算机学 | computer science | 计算机, 计算机科学 |

All other School 学校 words are graded exactly.
